dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed type of run records. Its constructor D027 packages matrices, vectors, numerical parameters, structural assumptions, factorization-error assumptions, and two perturbed triangular solve equations for indices b, p, and r.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target is universally quantified over such a bundled run, so every conclusion is conditional on the data and proofs required to construct this record.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the square matrix A of dimension (p*b) by (p*b) from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A occurs in the residual equation and both matrix-error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the square matrix L of dimension (p*b) by (p*b) from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: L contributes to the combined matrix and right-hand-side errors and to the scale ||L||_F ||U||_F ||xHat||_2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the square matrix U of dimension (p*b) by (p*b) from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: U contributes to the combined matrix error and to the scale ||L||_F ||U||_F ||xHat||_2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the real parameter epsilon from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Epsilon appears in the factor-error bounds through xi*epsilon and K*u*epsilon.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the total factorization-error matrix factorError.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the first term in the deterministically defined combined matrix error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the nonnegative real factorMixedConstant, denoted K.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes the additive term K*u*epsilon to both matrix-error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the lower-factor perturbation matrix lowerError.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes lowerError*U and lowerError*upperError to the matrix error and lowerError*upperRhsError to the right-hand-side error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the lower-solve right-hand-side perturbation vector lowerRhsError.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the first term in the combined right-hand-side error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting one of the two recompression tags in LocalDef028.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the threshold tag, it selects the exact value of xi.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting one of the two threshold tags in LocalDef029.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the recompression tag, it selects the exact value of xi.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the real unit-roundoff parameter u.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines every gamma coefficient and occurs in K*u*epsilon and 16*c^2*u^2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the upper-factor perturbation matrix upperError.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes L*upperError and lowerError*upperError to the combined matrix error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the upper-solve right-hand-side perturbation vector upperRhsError.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes L*upperRhsError and lowerError*upperRhsError to the combined right-hand-side error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the original right-hand-side vector v of length p*b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the residual equation and all right-hand-side error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the computed-solution vector xHat of length p*b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the residual equation and in the scale ||L||_F ||U||_F ||xHat||_2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: For n, the type of real n by n matrices, represented as functions Fin n -> Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes all square-matrix dimensions, principally n=p*b.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: For n, the type of real vectors of length n, represented as functions Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the dimensions of v, yHat, xHat, and the right-hand-side error vectors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number c = b + 2*r*sqrt(r) + p, with natural numbers cast to reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines gamma_c and gamma_{3c} and occurs in the explicit upper bound 16*c^2*u^2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: A four-case coefficient xi determined by recompression and threshold tags: xi=1 for (LocalDef038, LocalDef041), xi=p for (LocalDef038, LocalDef040), xi=p for (LocalDef037, LocalDef041), and xi=p^2/sqrt(6) for (LocalDef037, LocalDef040).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The selected xi multiplies epsilon in both matrix-error bounds and in a bundled factor-core error hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: For matrices E_f, E_L, E_U, L, and U, it returns E_f + E_L*U + L*E_U + E_L*E_U.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the combined matrix error DeltaA used in the residual equality and matrix norm bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: For vectors f_L, f_U and matrices L, E_L, it returns f_L + L*f_U + E_L*f_U.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the combined right-hand-side error deltav used in the residual equality and vector norm bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius norm of a real square matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every matrix norm in the assumptions, scales, and conclusions is the Frobenius norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coefficient gamma(k,u) = k*u/(1-k*u).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines gamma_p, gamma_c, and gamma_{3c}, which occur throughout the stated bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary matrix-vector multiplication: (A*x)_i = sum_j A_ij*x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the residual equation and both perturbed triangular solve equations their standard matrix-vector meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean vector norm ||x||_2 = sqrt(sum_i x_i^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every vector norm in the assumptions, scale, and right-hand-side conclusions is the Euclidean norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for a run. It requires b>0, p>0, r<=b; an opaque two-valued mode; threshold and recompression tags; matrices A,L,U and vector v; two-sided invertibility of A; rank-at-most-r factorizations of every off-diagonal b by b block of A,L,U; block-lower-triangular L and block-upper-triangular U; epsilon>0, u>0, u<epsilon, and 3*c*u<1; factorError=factorCoreError+factorMixedError; L*U=A+factorError; stated Frobenius bounds on the two factor-error parts with a nonnegative constant K; and vectors and perturbations satisfying two perturbed triangular solves and four stated matrix/vector norm bounds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are the complete hypotheses hidden inside the binder run. The target introduces no additional assumptions beyond possession of such a constructor value.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: An inductive type with exactly the two constructors LocalDef037 and LocalDef038, serving as the recompression choice.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its selected constructor controls one coordinate of the four-case definition of xi.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: An inductive type with exactly the two constructors LocalDef040 and LocalDef041, serving as the threshold choice.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its selected constructor controls one coordinate of the four-case definition of xi.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural number 1+1, namely 2, is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies elaboration evidence for the real numeral 2 used in c; it adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural number 5+1, namely 6, is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies elaboration evidence for the real numeral 6 in p^2/sqrt(6); it adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: The dependent four-way case eliminator for a LocalDef028 tag and a LocalDef029 tag.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the four explicit branches defining xi.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary square-matrix multiplication: (A*B)_ij = sum_k A_ik*B_kj.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the matrix products in DeltaA and in the bundled factorization, invertibility, and low-rank assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any real m by n matrix A, sqrt(sum_i sum_j A_ij^2), its Frobenius norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the underlying definition used by LocalDef023 for every matrix norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: An opaque inductive type with constructors LocalDef047 and LocalDef048.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A run stores one value of this type, but the value is never inspected and has no effect on any target formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: The two-way dependent case eliminator for LocalDef028, taking the LocalDef038 branch first and the LocalDef037 branch second.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It performs the outer case split used by the four-case xi definition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: One constructor of LocalDef028, selected by the second branch of its eliminator.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With threshold LocalDef041 it gives xi=p, and with LocalDef040 it gives xi=p^2/sqrt(6).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: One constructor of LocalDef028, selected by the first branch of its eliminator.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With threshold LocalDef041 it gives xi=1, and with LocalDef040 it gives xi=p.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: The two-way dependent case eliminator for LocalDef029, taking the LocalDef041 branch first and the LocalDef040 branch second.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It performs the inner threshold case split used by the four-case xi definition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: One constructor of LocalDef029, selected by the second branch of its eliminator.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects xi=p with LocalDef038 and xi=p^2/sqrt(6) with LocalDef037.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: One constructor of LocalDef029, selected by the first branch of its eliminator.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects xi=1 with LocalDef038 and xi=p with LocalDef037.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real m by n matrices, represented as functions Fin m -> Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the rectangular b by r matrices used as low-rank block factors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a (p*b) by (p*b) matrix M, it asserts that there are families X_ij,Y_ij of b by r matrices such that every off-diagonal block M_ij equals X_ij*Y_ij^T.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A run requires this rank-at-most-r off-diagonal block representation separately for A, L, and U, although the witnesses do not occur in the conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: Block lower triangularity: for block indices i<j, the b by b block L_ij is zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A run requires L to be block lower triangular; this property is not restated in the conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: Block upper triangularity: for block indices j<i, the b by b block U_ij is zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A run requires U to be block upper triangular; this property is not restated in the conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: Two-sided matrix invertibility: there exists Ainv with Ainv*A=I and A*Ainv=I.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A run requires A to be invertible, but no inverse occurs in the target conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: One constructor of the opaque mode type LocalDef035.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selecting it changes no target expression or conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: The other constructor of the opaque mode type LocalDef035.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selecting it changes no target expression or conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: The primitive dependent recursor for the two constructors of LocalDef028.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the recompression case split underlying LocalDef036 and hence xi.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: The primitive dependent recursor for the two constructors of LocalDef029.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the threshold case split underlying LocalDef039 and hence xi.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: The n by n identity matrix, with entry 1 on the diagonal and 0 off the diagonal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives exact meaning to the two-sided invertibility assumption on A.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: For b by r matrices X and Y, the b by b matrix X*Y^T.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines each low-rank off-diagonal block factorization required for A, L, and U.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: The b by b block M_ij of a (p*b) by (p*b) matrix M, whose row and column indices are i*b+row and j*b+col.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the blocks used in the low-rank and block-triangularity assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: The flattening map from a block index i in Fin p and an in-block index row in Fin b to i*b+row in Fin(p*b).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the exact block layout used by LocalDef053.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication of an m by n matrix and an n by p matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms X*Y^T in each off-diagonal block factorization.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix transpose, sending an m by n matrix A to the n by m matrix with entry A_ij at position (j,i).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It transposes Y in each factorization X*Y^T.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that i*b+row is strictly less than p*b whenever i is in Fin p and row is in Fin b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the flattened block index in LocalDef054 well-defined and adds no extra hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It combines the residual equality and seven inequalities into one proposition in the displayed nested order.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division operation supplied by a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it supplies ordinary division in gamma coefficients and the finite right-hand-side coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality between two values of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the residual identity and the exact equations packaged in a run.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type consisting of natural numbers strictly below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes all matrix rows, columns, vector entries, block indices, and in-block indices.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous addition operation selected by the relevant addition instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It becomes ordinary real addition, pointwise matrix/vector addition, or natural addition according to context.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous division operation selected by the relevant division instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It becomes ordinary real division in gamma(k,u) and in the finite right-hand-side coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous multiplication operation selected by the relevant multiplication instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It becomes natural multiplication in dimensions and real multiplication in scalar coefficients and norm products.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous power operation selected by the relevant power instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real bases and natural exponents it gives the squares in norms, coefficients, and 16*c^2*u^2.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous subtraction operation selected by the relevant subtraction instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms denominators 1-k*u and the higher-order coefficient H=F-gamma_p.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an ordered type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it expresses all norm and coefficient inequalities in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.add
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise addition of matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets A+DeltaA and all sums of matrix perturbations entrywise.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural-number exponentiation supplied by a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it interprets every exponent 2 as ordinary squaring.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the domain of b, p, r and all finite dimensions and exponents.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical cast from natural numbers into a type with natural-number casts.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It embeds b, p, and r into the reals in c, gamma_p, and xi.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given a nonzero natural n, it proves n+1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is numeral-elaboration evidence for real constants at least two and adds no mathematical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that every successor n+1 is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports numeral-elaboration proofs and adds no mathematical content.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of a natural-number literal in a type carrying the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets literals such as 0, 1, 2, 3, 6, and 16 in their real or natural contexts.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: The numeral-1 instance induced by a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets real 1 in gamma denominators and in (1+gamma_c)^2.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise addition of dependent functions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets addition of vectors, and under matrix definitions contributes to entrywise matrix addition.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All entries, norms, error parameters, and coefficients are real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies all scalar additions and the pointwise additions inherited by vectors and matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplicative, inverse, division, and integer-power structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies ordinary real division for all rational coefficients in the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard less-than-or-equal order on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives every displayed inequality its usual real-order meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplicative monoid structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real natural powers, especially squaring.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies all scalar products of coefficients, norms, epsilon, and u.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical embedding of natural numbers into the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets b, p, r, and real numerals appearing in the definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative identity 1 in the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real constant 1 in gamma denominators and coefficient formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary subtraction on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets 1-k*u and H=F-gamma_p.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive identity 0 in the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the lower bound 0<=H and zero entries in matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: The numeral-0 instance induced by a type's additive identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the real zero in the nonnegativity conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous heterogeneous-addition instance induced by an ordinary Add instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects the generic hAdd notation to ordinary addition for reals, vectors, matrices, and naturals.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous heterogeneous-division instance induced by an ordinary Div instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects generic hDiv notation to ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous heterogeneous-multiplication instance induced by an ordinary Mul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects generic hMul notation to ordinary real or natural multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous-power instance induced by an ordinary Pow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects generic power notation to real natural powers.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous heterogeneous-subtraction instance induced by an ordinary Sub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects generic hSub notation to ordinary real subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: instMulNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the common matrix/vector dimension exactly p*b.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a type with natural casts, it interprets any proven-at-least-two numeral by casting that natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets real constants such as 2, 3, 6, and 16 without adding hypotheses.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural-number literal n interpreted as the natural number n itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural literals used as dimensions, exponents, and numeral-elaboration evidence.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite enumeration of all elements of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits sums over every row, column, and vector index.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finite summation in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines matrix multiplication, matrix-vector multiplication, and the squared Frobenius and Euclidean norms.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes each sum range over all valid finite indices.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in alpha is a function m -> n -> alpha.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the function representation underlying all square, rectangular, and block matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard additive commutative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies finite real summation in products and norms.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonnegative real square-root operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in c, in xi=p^2/sqrt(6), and in the definitions of Frobenius and Euclidean norms.

dependency_coverage.name: Unit
dependency_coverage.meaning: A one-element type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used only to thunk the four branches of the xi case eliminator and contributes no mathematical data.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict-order relation supplied by an LT instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses positivity, u<epsilon, 3*c*u<1, natural positivity, and block-index ordering.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.AtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: The proposition/typeclass asserting that a natural numeral is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports elaboration of real numerals at least two and adds no substantive assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard strict order on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the bundled inequalities epsilon>0, u>0, u<epsilon, and 3*c*u<1 their usual meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: Unit.unit
dependency_coverage.meaning: The unique inhabitant of Unit.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It invokes each constant branch in the xi case eliminator and has no mathematical effect.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in flattened block indices i*b+row and in numeral-elaboration proofs.

dependency_coverage.name: instLENat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard less-than-or-equal order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the run condition r<=b.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets b>0, p>0, finite-index bounds, and flattened-index bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It quantifies the inverse of A and the X,Y witness families for each off-diagonal low-rank block representation.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.zero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The pointwise zero matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the zero b by b block in the block-triangularity assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Ne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Inequality a!=b, defined as the negation of a=b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts the rank-at-most-r block factorization requirement to off-diagonal block pairs.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTFin
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict order on Fin n inherited from the natural values of its elements.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines i<j and j<i in the block lower- and upper-triangularity conditions.

dependency_coverage.meaning: Decidable equality on Fin n.

binders: Universally quantified natural numbers b, p, and r.
A bundled run containing an opaque two-valued mode, a threshold tag t in the two-element type {LocalDef041, LocalDef040}, and a recompression tag q in the two-element type {LocalDef038, LocalDef037}.
Real (p*b) by (p*b) matrices A, L, U, factorCoreError, factorMixedError, factorError, lowerError, and upperError.
Real vectors v, yHat, xHat, lowerRhsError, and upperRhsError of length p*b.
Real parameters epsilon, unit roundoff u, and factorMixedConstant K.
hypotheses: A is two-sided invertible: there exists Ainv such that Ainv*A=I and A*Ainv=I.

For each M in {A,L,U}, there exist families X^M_ij and Y^M_ij of real b by r matrices such that M_ij=X^M_ij*(Y^M_ij)^T for every pair of distinct block indices i,j in Fin p. Here M_ij is the b by b block with entries M(i*b+s,j*b+t).
L is block lower triangular: L_ij=0 whenever i<j.
U is block upper triangular: U_ij=0 whenever j<i.
epsilon>0, u>0, u<epsilon, and 3*c*u<1, where c=b+2*r*sqrt(r)+p.
mathematical_definitions: Let n=p*b. All principal matrices are n by n and all principal vectors have length n.
For an n by n matrix M, ||M||_F=sqrt(sum_i sum_j M_ij^2). For a length-n vector x, ||x||_2=sqrt(sum_i x_i^2).
Matrix multiplication and matrix-vector multiplication are the ordinary finite-sum operations.
The b by b block M_ij has entry M(i*b+s,j*b+t) at in-block indices s,t in Fin b.
c=b+2*r*sqrt(r)+p, with b,p,r regarded as real numbers in this formula.
For real k, gamma_k=k*u/(1-k*u). Thus gamma_p=p*u/(1-p*u), gamma_c=c*u/(1-c*u), and gamma_{3c}=3*c*u/(1-3*c*u).
The coefficient xi is 1 for (q,t)=(LocalDef038,LocalDef041), p for (LocalDef038,LocalDef040), p for (LocalDef037,LocalDef041), and p^2/sqrt(6) for (LocalDef037,LocalDef040).
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every bundled run satisfying the stated dimension, block-structure, invertibility, factorization, positivity, factor-error, and perturbed-solve conditions, the deterministically combined errors DeltaA and deltav satisfy the exact residual equation (A+DeltaA)xHat=v+deltav. The Frobenius norm of DeltaA obeys both an expanded bound using 3*gamma_c+gamma_c^2 and a bound using gamma_{3c}. The Euclidean norm of deltav obeys three successive bounds: one with the finite coefficient F, an algebraically separated form with H=F-gamma_p, and a form replacing H by 16*c^2*u^2. Finally, H is explicitly asserted to lie between 0 and 16*c^2*u^2.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The theorem quantifies over a run record rather than stating its assumptions as implications. For any b,p,r for which no such run exists, the universal statement is vacuous; in particular, the constructor cannot produce a run when b=0 or p=0.

The off-diagonal rank condition applies only to distinct p by p block positions. It imposes no corresponding factorization on diagonal blocks, and each of A, L, and U may use independent existential witness families.
The parameter r may be zero. In that case, the required b by r products force every represented off-diagonal block to be zero.
All matrix norms in the proposition are Frobenius norms, not spectral or induced operator norms; all vector norms are Euclidean norms.

The assumption 3*c*u<1, together with b>0, p>0, r<=b, and u>0, ensures the displayed gamma denominators and 1-gamma_p are positive. Lean's real division is nevertheless a total operation syntactically.
The errors, intermediate vector yHat, and solution xHat are supplied as data satisfying assumptions. The proposition does not assert their existence from A and v alone.
The opaque mode value in LocalDef035 has no effect on the target. The threshold and recompression tags affect the target only through the four explicit values of xi.

No floating-point operation semantics, rounding process, algorithm execution, uniqueness statement, or claim that xHat was generated by a particular algorithm is encoded beyond the bundled equations and inequalities.
ambiguities: The dossier gives no application-level interpretation or descriptive names for the two constructors of LocalDef035, LocalDef028, or LocalDef029. Their exact structural roles and the resulting four values of xi are determined, but their intended algorithmic labels are not.
